overall: The AG found the Mayor's Work Group on Panhandling is an advisory committee to a single mayor under the Connelly exception, so it is not a public body and did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the mayor's panhandling work group is a public body that met at least ten times without complying with Open Meeting Law requirements.
Complaint alleged the work group failed to comply with the notice and minutes requirements of the Open Meeting Law across its meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore conclude that the Work Group meets the standards of the Connelly exception and is therefore not subject to the Open Meeting Law and did not violate its requirements.
